name: Kushiro (Japan, town)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kushiro town emblem in white: a broken ring of concentric arcs around a square.
history: Municipal flag of Kushiro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 September 1959.

features.role: Kushiro town emblem — a broken ring of concentric arcs around a square
